arabic text: AKBAR TUMHE MALOOM HAI KYAA MAANG RAHE HO\nTUM BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZAA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: OH AKBAR, DO YOU REALISE WHAT YOU’RE ASKING ME FOR?\nYOU ARE ASKING YOUR FATHER FOR PERMISSION TO LET YOU BECOME A MARTYR!

arabic text: ISS AALAM E GHURBAT ME TUMHE JAANE DOON KAISE\nISS DAHSTE MUSIBAT ME TUMHE JAANE DOON KAISE
english translation text: IN THIS STATE OF LONELINESS, HOW DO I LET YOU GO?\nIN THIS LAND OF CALAMITIES, HOW DO I LET YOU GO?

arabic text: ISS WAQT E QIYAMAT ME TUMHE JAANE DOON KAISE\nAY LAAL JO TUM ISNE VIGA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: IN A TIME OF PURE DEVASTATION, HOW DO I LET YOU GO?\nOH MY BELOVED CHILD, ARE YOU REALLY ASKING ME FOR PERMISSION TO LET YOU BECOME A MARTYR?

arabic text: TUM BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZAA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: YOU ARE ASKING YOUR FATHER FOR PERMISSION TO LET YOU BECOME A MARTYR!

arabic text: KYAA GUZREGI ISS BAAP KE DIL PAR NAHIN SOCHA\nTU NE YE MERI JAAN ALI AKBAR NAHIN SOCHA
english translation text: BEFORE YOU ASKED, DID YOU NOT CONSIDER WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO YOUR FATHER’S HEART?\nOH MY BELOVED SON, ALI AKBAR, DID YOU NOT THINK OF THIS?

arabic text: MAR JAAOON GA ME TUJ SE BICHAR KAR NAHIN SOCHA\nTUM MUJ SE ZAIFI KA ASAA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: THAT I WILL PASS AWAY IF I AM SEPARATED FROM YOU?\nYOU ARE ASKING FOR MY SUPPORT FOR MY OLD AGE!

arabic text: DIL ROTA HAI NAZRON SE AGAR DUR HO BETA\nKIS TARHA JUDAYI TERI MANZUR HO BETA
english translation text: THE HEART CRIES WHEN YOU ARE FAR FROM MY SIGHT, OH MY SON\nSO HOW CAN I ACCEPT THE SEPARATION FROM YOU, OH MY SON?

arabic text: TUM HI MERI AANKHEN HO MERA NOOR HO BETA\nMUJSE MERI AANKHON KI ZIYAA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: WHEN YOU ARE MY EYES AND THE LIGHT WITH WHICH I SEE, OH MY SOON\nYOU ARE NOW ASKING ME FOR THE LIGHT OF MY EYES

arabic text: DUNIYA SE GAYAA JIS GHARI MEHBOOB KHUDA KA\nNANA KI ZIYARAT KO TARAP TA THAA NAWASAA
english translation text: AT THE TIME WHEN THE BELOVED OF ALLAH SWT (THE PROPHET SAW) LEFT THIS WORLD\nI, HIS GRANDSON (IMAM HUSSAIN AS) WOULD YEARN TO SEE HIM AGAIN.

arabic text: AY LAAL TUJE ISS LIYE KHAALIQ SE THAA MAANGA\nMAQBOOL HUWI MERI DUA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: OH MY BELOVED SON, THIS IS WHY I ASKED ALLAH SWT FOR A SON LIKE YOU (WHO RESEMBLES THE PROPHET SAW)\nAND NOW YOU ARE ASKING FOR THE ANSWER OF MY DUA TO BE TAKEN AWAY!

arabic text: ISLAM PE KHUD APNA LAHOO MUH PE BAHAA WO\nSINE PE SINAA SHAAN SE MEDAAN ME KHAAWO
english translation text: DO YOU WISH FOR YOUR BLOOD TO BE SHED IN THIS BATTLEFIELD FOR THE SAKE OF ISLAM?\nDO YOU WISH TO TAKE THE SPEARS ON YOUR CHEST WITH UTMOST GRACE IN THIS BATTLEFIELD?

arabic text: TASWEER PAYAMBAR KI TAN-E-KHAAQ MILAWO\nKYAA ISS LIYE MARNE KI RIZAA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: THE IMAGE OF THE PROPHET SAW WILL THEN FALL TO THE GROUND!\nIS THIS THE REASON YOU ARE ASKING FOR MY PERMISSION TO BECOME A MARTYR?

arabic text: EK ROZ TUJE AAN KE MAANGAA THAA PHUPI NE\nATHARA BARAS NAAZON SE PAALAA THAA PHUPI NE
english translation text: ONE DAY YOUR AUNT CAME AND ASKED FOR YOU\nFOR 18 YEARS YOUR AUNT HAS LOVINGLY RAISED YOU

arabic text: BETON SE BHI ZIYADA TUMHE CHAHAATA PHUPI NE\nEHSAN JO ZAINAB NE KIYAA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: SHE NURTURED YOU MORE THAN HER OWN SONS\nYOU ARE ASKING FOR THE SACRIFICES THAT ZAINAB (SA) HAS MADE FOR YOU TO BE NULLIFIED

arabic text: RAKH THE NAHIN TUM ISKI KHABAR AY MERE PYAARE\nKIS DARJAA MOHABAT HAI TERI DIL ME HAMAARE
english translation text: OH MY DEAR ONE, YOU HAVE NO IDEA OF\nJUST HOW MUCH I HAVE LOVED YOU AS A SON FROM THE BOTTOM OF MY HEART

arabic text: NANA KI MERE SHAKL HAI PAYKAR ME TUMHARE\nTUM SURAAT E MEHBOOB E KHUDA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: YOU ARE AN EMBODIMENT OF MY MATERNAL GRANDFATHER!\nYOU ARE ASKING ME FOR PERMISSION TO TAKE THE FACE OF THE PROPHET SAW AWAY FROM ME!

arabic text: SAR TERA BHI JIS WAQT CHARHE GA SAR-E-NEZA\nHOGA SAR E MEDAAN JUDAA SAR BHI TUMHAARA
english translation text: AT THE TIME WHEN YOUR HEAD WILL BE RAISED ON THE HEAD OF A SPEAR\nFOR EVEN YOUR HEAD SHALL BE SEVERED IN THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: HAMSHAKL PAYAMBAR KA GALA KAATENGE AADAA\nGOYA MERE NANA KA GALA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: THE NECK OF THE LOOKALIKE OF THE PROPHET SAW WILL BE CUT BY THE ENEMIES\nIT’S AS IF YOU ARE ASKING ME TO SACRIFICE THE NECK OF MY MATERNAL GRANDFATHER

arabic text: AKAA MUJHE MAALOOM HAI KYAA MAANG RAHA HOON\nEK BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZAA MAANG RAHA HOON
english translation text: ALI AKBAR ADDRESSES HIS FATHER: OH FATHER I KNOW WHAT I AM ASKING FOR\nI AM ASKING FOR THE PERMISSION TO BE MARTYRED FROM A FATHER!

arabic text: BABA MUJHE AMMA NE BHI KUCH DARS DIYA HAI\nAADAB E WAFAA SE MUJHE AGAAH KIYA HAI
english translation text: OH FATHER, MY MOTHER HAS ALSO BEEN TEACHING ME A FEW LESSONS\nSHE HAS TAUGHT ME ABOUT THE ETIQUETTES OF BEING LOYAL TO THE IMAM

arabic text: PEHLE ME MAROON AAP SE WADAA YE LIYA HAI\nBAS ISS LIYE MARNE KI RIZAA MAANG RAHA HOON
english translation text: SHE MADE ME PROMISE THAT I WILL BE MARTYRED BEFORE YOU\nFOR THIS REASON, I AM ASKING FOR YOUR PERMISSION TO BECOME A MARTYR

arabic text: EIK BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZAA MAANG RAHA HOON
english translation text: I AM ASKING FOR PERMISSION FROM A FATHER TO LET HIS SON BE MARTYRED!

arabic text: AKAA MUJHE MAALOOM HAI KYAA MAANG RAHA HOON\nEK BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZAA MAANG RAHA HOON
english translation text: ALI AKBAR ADDRESSES HIS FATHER: OH MY MASTER (FATHER) I KNOW WHAT I AM ASKING FOR\nI AM ASKING FOR THE PERMISSION TO BE MARTYRED FROM A FATHER!

arabic text: HAI AAP TO BABA BIN KHAATOON QAYAMAT\nAUR MAA HAI MRI APNA SI K PEHKAR ISMAT
english translation text: YOU, MY FATHER, ARE THE SON OF THE LADY OF THE WORLDS (TITLE OF BIBI FATIMA SA)\nAND MY MOTHER TOO IS AN EMBODIMENT OF PURITY

arabic text: KYA SIN MEIN US PAI NAHIN KUCH JALBAH ISMAT\nMAI MAADER E MUZTAR KA KAHAA MAANG RAHAA HOON
english translation text: HER HEART HAS NOTHING BUT HONOURABLE EMOTIONS\nI AM ASKING FOR WHAT MY RESTLESS MOTHER HAS ASKED FOR.

arabic text: BABA MUJHE EHWALE DILE ZOR PATA HAI\nAY SAKT BOHOT MANZIL E DUSHAR PATA HAI
english translation text: OH FATHER, I AM AWARE OF THE CONDITION OF YOUR BROKEN HEART\nI RECOGNISE THAT MY KILLING WILL BE EXTREMELY HARSH ON YOU.

arabic text: AUR DEEN KA MUSHKIL ME HAI SARDAR PATAA HAI\nYOON AAP SE MARNE KI RIZAA MAANG RAHA HOON
english translation text: I RECOGNISE THAT THE MASTER OF OUR RELIGION (IMAM HUSSAIN AS) IS FACING TREMENDOUS DIFFICULTY\nAND NOW HERE I AM, ASKING FOR YOUR PERMISSION TO BECOME A MARTYR

arabic text: AKBER TUMHE MAALOOM HAI KIA MAANG RAHE HO?\nTUM BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: AKBER, DO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE SEEKING?\nYOU ARE SEEKING YOUR FATHER’S PERMISSION TO DIE

arabic text: ISS WAQT-E-QAYAMAT MEIN TUMHE JAANE DOON KAISE?
english translation text: HOW, IN THIS TIME OF DISASTER, CAN I LET YOU GO?

arabic text: AY LAAL JO TUM IZN-E-WIDA MAANG RAHE HO\nTUM BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: O BELOVED! THAT YOU ARE SEEKING THE PERMISSION OF FAREWELL\nYOU ARE SEEKING YOUR FATHER’S PERMISSION TO DIE

arabic text: KIA GUZRE GI ISS BAAP KE DIL PER NAHIIN SOCHA?\nTUM ME HAI MERI JAAN YE AKBAR NAHIIN SOCHA?
english translation text: WHAT WILL THIS FATHER ENDURE, HAVEN’T YOU THOUGHT?\nTHAT MY LIFE RESIDES IN YOU, HAVEN’T YOU THOUGHT?

arabic text: MAR JAWUNGA MAIN TUM SE BICHHAR KER NAHIIN SOCHA?\nTUM MUJHSE ZAIIFI KI AZA MANG RAHE HO
english translation text: THAT I WILL DIE BY YOUR SEPARATION, HAVEN’T YOU THOUGHT?\nYOU ARE SEEKING MY SORROW IN OLD AGE

arabic text: TUM BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZA MAANG RAHE HO\nDUNIA SE GAYA JISS GHARRHI MEHBOOB KHUDA KA
english translation text: YOU ARE SEEKING YOUR FATHER’S PERMISSION TO DIE\nWHEN GOD’S BELOVED DEPARTED THIS WORLD

arabic text: NANA KI ZIYARAT KO TARASTA THA NAWASA\nAAY LAAL TUJHE ISS LIYE KHAALIQ SE THA MAANGA
english translation text: THE GRANDSON YEARNED TO SEE HIS GRANDFATHER\nO BELOVED! THAT IS WHY I SOUGHT YOU FROM THE CREATOR

arabic text: MAQBUL HUI MERI DUA MAANG RAHE HO\nTUM BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text: MY PRAYERS WERE ANSWERED (THAT YOU NOW WISH ME TO GIVE UP)\nYOU ARE SEEKING YOUR FATHER’S PERMISSION TO DIE

arabic text: EK ROZ TUMHE AAKE MAANGA THA PHUPI NE\nATTHARA BARAS NAZON SE PAALA THA PHUPI NE
english translation text: A DAY CAME WHEN YOUR AUNT SOUGHT YOU\nAND FOR EIGHTEEN YEARS, DID SHE GENTLY RAISE YOU

arabic text: TUM BAAP SE MARNE KI RIZA MAANG RAHE HO\nDIL ROTA HAI NAZRON SE AAGAR DUR HO BETA
english translation text: YOU ARE SEEKING YOUR FATHER’S PERMISSION TO DIE\nMY HEART WEEPS IF YOU STRAY FAR FROM MY EYES, O SON!

arabic text: KIS TARHA JUDAI TERI MANZOOR HO BETA\nTUM HI MERI AANKHE HO MERI NOOR HO BETA
english translation text: HOW CAN I ACCEPT YOUR SEPARATION, O SON!\nYOU ARE THE LIGHT OF MY EYES, O SON!

arabic text: BABA BABA BABA\nBABA MUJHE MAALOOM HAI KIA MAANG RAHA HOON
english translation text: FATHER! FATHER! FATHER!\nFATHER, I KNOW WHAT I AM SEEKING FROM YOU.

arabic text: EK BAAPSE MARNE KI RIZA MAANG RAHA HOON\nBABA MUJHE AMMA NE BHI KUCH DARS DIA HAI
english translation text: I AM SEEKING A FATHER’S PERMISSION TO DIE\nFATHER, MY MOTHER HAS TAUGHT ME SOMETHING

arabic text: AADA BE WAFA SE MUJHE AAGHAH KIA HAI\nPAHLE MEIN MAROON AAPSE WAADA YEH LIA HAI
english translation text: SHE HAS MADE ME AWARE OF THE TREACHEROUS ENEMY\nTHAT I SHOULD PRECEDE YOU IN DEATH, SHE HAS TAKEN A PROMISE

arabic text: BASS IS LIYE MARNE KI RIZA MAANG RAHA HOON\nEK BAPSE MARNE KI RIZA MAANG RAHA HOON
english translation text: AND SO, I SEEK PERMISSION TO DIE\nI AM SEEKING A FATHER’S PERMISSION TO DIE

arabic text:
IS AALAME GHURBAT MEIN TUMHE JAANE DOON KAISE,
IS DASHTE MUSIBAT MEIN TUMHE JAANE DOON KAISE,
IS WAQTE KAYAMAT MEIN TUMHE JAANE DOON KAISE,
AY LAAL JO TUM IZNE WIGAA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text:
HOW CAN I LET YOU GO IN THESE DIFFICULT TIMES,
HOW CAN I LET YOU GO IN THIS TROUBLED DESERT,
HOW CAN I LET YOU GO IN THIS DAY OF JUDGEMENT,
OH MY BELOVED! YOU ARE ASKING PERMISSION FROM ME TO DIE.

arabic text:
KYA GUZREGI ISS BAAP KE DIL PAR NAHIN SOCHA
TUMNE YE MERI JAAN ALI AKBAR NAHIN SOCHA
MAR JAUNGA MAIN TUJHSE BICHHAD KAR NAHI SOCHA
TUM MUJHSE ZAEEFI KA ASAA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text:
DID YOU NOT THINK WHAT WILL GO THROUGH YOUR FATHERS HEART,
ALI AKBAR MY BELOVED! DID YOU NOT THINK THIS THROUGH,
DID YOU NOT THINK I WILL DIE FROM YOUR SEPARATION,
YOU ARE ASKING FROM ME THE SUPPORT OF MY OLD AGE

arabic text:
DIL ROTA HAIN NAZRON SE AGAR DOOR HO BETA
KIS TARHA JUDAAI TERI MANZOOR HO BETA
TUM HI MERI ANKHEIN HO MERA NOOR HO BETA
MUJHSE MERI ANKHON KI ZIYA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text:
MY SON MY HEART CRIES FOR YOU WHEN YOU ARE AWAY FROM ME,
MY SON HOW CAN I ACCEPT YOUR SEPARATION FROM ME,
YOU ARE THE LIGHT OF MY EYES MY SON,
YOU ARE ASKING ME TO GIVE MY LIGHT FOREVER.

arabic text:
DUNIYA SE GAYA JIS GHADI MEHBOOB KHUDA KA
NANA KI ZIYARAT KO TADAPTA THA NAWASSA
AYE LAAL TUJHE IS LIYE KHAALIK SE THA MANGA
MAQBOOL HUWI MERI DUA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text:
WHEN THE BELOVED PROPHET OF ALLAH LEFT THIS WORLD,
I, HIS GRANDSON WAS DESPERATE TO SEE HIM AGAIN,
O MY SON I HAD PRAYED TO ALLAH FOR YOUR BIRTH AS YOU RESEMBLE HIM,
YOU ARE ASKING ME TO LET GO THE ACCEPTANCE OF MY PRAYER.

arabic text:
EK ROZ TUJHE AAN KE MANGA THA PHUPHI NE
ATTHARA BARAS NAAZON SE PAALA THA PHUPHI NE
BETON SE BHI ZYADA TUMHE CHAHA THA PHUPHI NE
EHSAAN JO ZAINAB (S.A.) NE KIYA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text:
YOUR AUNT ZAINAB (A.S) HAD ASKED FOR YOU IN HER PRAYERS,
FOR EIGHTEEN YEARS SHE HAD LOVINGLY BROUGHT YOU UP,
YOUR AUNT LOVED YOU MORE THAN A SON,
YOU ARE NOW ASKING ME TO LET GO OF HER FAVOURS TO ME.

arabic text:
SAR TERA BHI JISS WAQT CHADHEGA SARE NAIZA
HOGA SARE MAIDAAN JUDA SAR BHI TUMHARA
HUM SHAKLE PAYAMBAR KA GALA KAATENGE AADAA
GOYA MERE NANA KA GALA MAANG RAHE HO
english translation text:
WHEN YOUR SEVERED HEAD WILL BE MOUNTED ON A SPEAR,
WHEN YOUR HEAD WILL BE SEVERED IN THE BATTLEFIELD,
THEY WILL CUT THE HEAD THAT RESEMBLES THE PROPHET,
IT IS AS IF YOU ARE ASKING FOR MY GRANDFATHER’S HEAD.

arabic text:
BABA MUJHE AMMA NE BHI KUCH DARS DIYA HAI
ADAB E WAFA SE MUJHE AAGAH KIYA HAI
PEHLE MEIN MARU AAP SE WADA YE LIYA HAI
BUSS IS LIYE MARNE KI RIZA MAANG RAHA HOON
english translation text:
FATHER, MY MOTHER HAS GIVEN ME SOME INSTRUCTIONS,
SHE HAS PUT ME FORWARD TO FULFILL MY LOYALTY TO YOU,
SHE HAS TAKEN A PROMISE FROM ME THAT I WILL DIE BEFORE YOU,
FOR THIS REASON I AM SEEKING PERMISSION FROM YOU TO DIE.

arabic text:
BABA MUJHE EHWAALE DILE ZAAR PATA HAI
HAI SAKHT BOHAT MANZILE DUSHWAAR PATA HAI
AUR DEEN KA MUSHKIL MEIN HAI SARDAAR PATA HAI
YUN AAP SE MARNE KI RIZA MANGU RAHA HOON
english translation text:
OH FATHER, I AM AWARE OF THE IMMENSE LOVE BETWEEN US,
I AM ALSO AWARE OF THE DIFFICULT GOALS WE NEED TO ACHIEVE,
I KNOW THE LEADER OF THE RELIGION IS IN GREAT DIFFICULTIES
FOR THIS REASON I AM SEEKING YOUR PERMISSION TO DIE
